sql.org.getAllForCompany: select o.*, p.org_name as parentOrgName, ot.org_type from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.company_id = :companyId order by o.org_name
sql.org.getSchedulingOrgs: select o.id, o.company_id, o.org_name, o.parent_org_id, o.org_type_id, o.active_flag, o.email, o.schedulable, o.available_to_children, o.state_id, p.org_name as parentOrgName, o.org_name as title, ot.org_type from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where case when :isParent and :isSchedulingTool then array[o.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else (o.company_id = :companyId OR (:isSchedulingTool AND o.company_id = :parentCompanyId AND o.available_to_children is true )) end and case when :stateId::integer is not null then o.state_id = :stateId::integer and o.schedulable is true else o.schedulable is true end and o.archived is not true and o.active_flag is true order by o.org_name
sql.org.getOrgsByType: select o.*, p.org_name as parentOrgName, ot.org_type from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.company_id = :companyId and o.org_type_id = :typeId order by o.org_name
sql.org.searchOrgs: select o.*, p.org_name as parentOrgName, ot.org_type from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.company_id = :companyId and o.org_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' order by o.org_name limit :limit offset :offset ;
sql.org.searchOrgCount: select count(*) from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.company_id = :companyId and o.org_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%'
sql.org.exportOrgs: select o.org_name, ot.org_type, p.org_name as "parent_org_name", o.active_flag from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.company_id = :companyId and o.org_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' order by o.org_name desc;
sql.org.updateOrg: update flow.org set org_name = :orgName, parent_org_id = :parentOrgId, org_type_id = :orgTypeId, schedulable = :schedulable, available_to_children = :availableToChildren, state_id = :stateId, active_flag = :active where id = :id
sql.org.insertOrg: insert into flow.org(company_id, org_name, parent_org_id, org_type_id, schedulable, state_id, available_to_children) values(:companyId, :orgName, :parentOrgId, :orgTypeId, :schedulable, :stateId, :availableToChildren)
sql.org.getOne: select o.*, p.org_name as parent_org_name, p.org_type_id as parent_org_type_id, ot.org_type from flow.org o left join flow.org p on p.id = o.parent_org_id inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.id = :id and o.company_id = :companyId
sql.org.getOrgFiltersForCompany: select of.id, of.org_level_id, ol.level_name, of.rank, ol.company_id, of.show_type from flow.org_filter of inner join flow.org_level ol on ol.id = of.org_level_id where ol.company_id = :companyId order by of.rank
sql.org.getOneOrgFilter: select of.id, of.org_level_id, ol.level_name, of.rank, ol.company_id, of.show_type from flow.org_filter of inner join flow.org_level ol on ol.id = of.org_level_id where of.id = :id
sql.org.updateOrgFilter: update flow.org_filter set org_level_id = :orgLevelId, rank = :rank, show_type = :showType where id = :id
sql.org.insertOrgFilter: insert into flow.org_filter(org_level_id, rank, show_type) values (:orgLevelId, :rank, :showType)
sql.org.getOrgsByHierarchyFilter: select * from flow.org_hierarchy_filter_down(ARRAY[ :selectedOrgs ]::integer[]) union select * from flow.org_hierarchy_filter_up(ARRAY[ :selectedOrgs ]::integer[]) order by org_level_id, org_name;
sql.org.getOrgsForLevel: select o.id, o.company_id, org_name, parent_org_id, org_type_id, active_flag, email, ot.org_type, ot.org_level_id from flow.org o inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = o.org_type_id where o.company_id = :companyId and ot.org_level_id = :orgLevelId order by o.org_name
